description: List the drafts saved in one mailbox: for each, the draftId (needed by send_draft), the message id, thread id, date, recipients, subject and a short snippet. Use it to check what is waiting to be sent, or to find a draft made earlier with create_draft. To read a draft's full text, pass its message id to read_email. Read-only.

account.description: Which mailbox: email address, alias, or local part. Optional when only one account is connected.

name: list_drafts
title: List drafts
